d.t: Decorative, coloured vinyl flake, low VOC epoxy floor
d.s: Sikafloor DecoDur ES-26 Flake is a decorative, multi-coloured, textured, vinyl flaked floor covering designed for a range of interior applications.
us: Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical industries and Healthcare facilities

Beware of condensation! The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3°C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.

When performing application work with Sikafloor Decodur ES-26 Flake, the substrate moisture content must not exceed 4 % pbw measured by Tramex. Test method: Sika-Tramex meter, CM - measurement or Oven-dry-method. No rising moisture according to ASTM (Polyethylene-sheet).

When performing application work with Sikafloor DecoDur ES-26 Flake, the substrate moisture content must not exceed 4 % pbw measured by Tramex. Test method: Sika-Tramex meter, CM - measurement or Oven-dry-method. No rising moisture according to ASTM (Polyethylene-sheet). Use Sikafloor 161 Primer for moisture up to 6%pbw.

Sikafloor DecoDur ES-26 Flake system Coating System | Product | Consumption Primer | 1–2 × Sikafloor-160/-161 | ~0.25-0.35 kg/m² Wearing coat | Sikafloor-264 | ~0.3-0.4 kg m² Broadcast | Broadcast in excess with Sika-PVA ColorFlakes 3 mm | ~0.45-0.65 kg/m² First seal coat | 1 × Sikafloor-169 | ~0.3-0.4 kg/m² Second seal coat | 1 × Sikafloor-169 | ~0.25 kg/m² Optional texture | White aluminium oxide 60 or 80 mesh to final coat | 4-6%by volume

Surfaces should be clean, dry and free of contaminants such as oil, grease and curing membranes . Substrate should be prepared to achieve a profile of CSP2 and should achieve a cohesive bond pull off test value of >1.5mpa. All unsound layers and any previous coatings are to be removed. Any imperfections in the substrate profile that will be visible in the finished product are to be filled using Sikafloor 160 mortar, scrape fill layer or Sikadur 33 depending on the depth of imperfections. Refer to Sikafloor 160/161 TDS for detailed information.
Refer to individual Sikafloor 160/161/264/169 TDS

Application of system layers - Refer to individual TDS for Sikafloor 160/161/264/169. Application of vinyl flakes can be graded as sparce, partial and full brodcast. The choice of these depends on how much of the base layer colour is desired to be visible in between the vinyl flakes. During the removal of excess flakes post broadcast, it is recommended that the remaining adhered flake surface be lightly sanded or scraped to remove any high peaks. This ensures a more even finish post application of the final coats of Sikafloor 169
Please refer to the Method Statement Sikafloor‐ Cleaning Regime

cp.text: Do not apply Sikafloor® DecoDur ES-26 Flake on substrates with rising moisture.
cp.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

cp.text: If heating is required do not use gas, oil, paraffin or other fossil fuel heaters, these produce large quantities of both CO2 and H2O water vapour, which may adversely affect the finish
